ReverseRingOfSevenCurses.title: Reverse Ring of Seven Curses
ReverseRingOfSevenCurses.description: Damage taken -50%, Non-boss damage dealt +25%, Block gained +20%, Gold gained +50%, Rest site heal +25%, Draw 1 card from draw pile each turn, Heal 10% max HP on boss kill. Energy -1, Draw -1, Card rewards include 1 extra Curse, Rest site upgrade -1.
ReverseRingOfSevenCurses.flavor: Seven curses reversed — fortune and misfortune entwined.
